use_cases: Displaying Gemini AI branding within profile dropdown navigation menus
Serving as an AI provider selection option in multi-model dropdown interfaces
Acting as a status or provider indicator in AI-related application headers
Used for AI service switching in chatbot or assistant integrations
ai_summary: A minimalist SVG icon component rendering Google's Gemini AI logo with a blue gradient circular design. This atomic component is designed as a selectable option within profile dropdowns and multi-provider AI selection interfaces, providing visual identification for Gemini-powered services.
